matches.rationale: Pred_2 discusses computational complexity of the SVD/ISVD operation, which is a different issue from the mathematical logic error in gt_1 (incorrect ordering and undefined orthogonality of matrices P_k and Q). The finding does not identify the core defect that the encryption step breaks feature aggregation logic.

Neither finding addresses equation (5) or the leverage score computation. Pred_1 focuses on equations 7 and 9 (temperature scaling), and pred_2 focuses on computational complexity in the appendix. The ill-formed matrix multiplication in the leverage score formula is not detected.

Pred_1 directly identifies the inconsistency between equations 7 and 9 regarding temperature scaling: different normalization factors (1/(N_old+N_new) vs separate 1/N_old and 1/N_new) and different softmax applications (separate vs joint). This matches gt_3's description of contradictory temperature scaling definitions between equations.

pred_verdicts.rationale: Correctly identifies the inconsistency between equations 7 and 9 in temperature scaling, matching gt_3.
Identifies a computational complexity claim issue not present in the ground truth defects.
